findings.desc: lattice-parallel-wave.ts excludes IDEA from selectable active stories, but isActiveStory() still treats IDEA as active. dependencySummary() and hotspotConflicts() therefore block or degrade recommendations based on IDEA stories that are not supposed to count as active scheduling peers. Use a single active-phase predicate so IDEA stays non-active everywhere.

parallel_wave_create / parallel_wave_inspect / parallel_plan were added to MAIN_TOOLS and command-policy, but they are missing from DEFAULT_PHASE_TOOLS. With any active story, isCommandAllowed() rejects them, so the new CLI surfaces are unavailable in normal PLAN/DEV/REVIEW/TEST sessions despite allowedPhases=all. Add them to DEFAULT_PHASE_TOOLS["*"] and cover the phase-gating path with a smoke test.
